items.headline: GST Council approves quarterly tax payment for small biz
items.what: GST Council ne optional quarterly tax payment scheme approve kiya hai chhote businesses ke liye. Ab chhote businesses mahine ke bajaye quarter mein tax file kar sakte hain.
items.who: Small businesses jo GST mein registered hain.
items.action: Agar eligible hain to quarterly payment scheme ka option select kar sakte hain apne GST portal par.

items.headline: GST Council reforms: Refund, registration, litigation par aasaaniyan
items.what: GST Council ne refund, registration aur litigation process ko simplify karne ke reforms announce kiye hain. Ye reforms GST compliance ko business-friendly banayenge.
items.who: All GST registered taxpayers.
items.action: GST portal par naye processes ke guidelines check karen aur accordingly filings aur refund claims karein.

items.headline: Rajasthan MSMEs ke liye digital invoice financing push
items.what: Rajasthan sarkar ne MSMEs ke cash flow ko behtar banane ke liye digital invoice financing ko promote karna shuru kiya hai.
items.who: Rajasthan ke MSME units jo invoice discounting solution use karte hain.
items.action: Eligible MSMEs apne invoices registered digital platform par upload karke financing option le sakte hain.

items.headline: Punjab mein leasehold to freehold conversion approve, 5% fee lagegi
items.what: Punjab sarkar ne industrial reforms mein leasehold property ko freehold mein convert karne ki approval de di hai. Is conversion par 5% fee lagegi.
items.who: Punjab ke industrial property holders jiski property leasehold par hai.
items.action: Interested industrial units sarkari process follow karke conversion ke liye apply kar sakte hain, 5% fee jama karani hogi.

items.headline: J&K City Gas Distribution Policy notify hua, PNG/CNG sabhi districts mein
items.what: Jammu & Kashmir sarkar ne City Gas Distribution Policy notify ki hai. Is policy ke tahat PNG (piped natural gas) aur CNG (compressed natural gas) ka expansion sabhi 20 districts mein hoga.
items.who: J&K ke industrial, commercial, aur residential gas consumers.
items.action: PNG/CNG connection ke liye application process aur distribution agency ki guidelines follow karein.

items.headline: Telangana me 41 new 2B Bar Licences ke liye applications invite
items.what: Telangana Excise Department ne 41 naye 2B Bar Licences ke liye applications mangi hain. Isse naye bar kholne ke mauke milenge.
items.who: Entrepreneurs aur businesses jo Telangana me nayi 2B bar kholna chahte hain.
items.action: Interested applicants application process aur eligibility terms Excise Department ki website se check karein aur taiyari shuru karein.

items.headline: Delhi-NCR mein purane trucks/buses ke liye badlao scheme Cabinet approve
items.what: Cabinet ne 9,585-crore rupaye ki scheme approve ki hai jisse Delhi-NCR region mein purane trucks aur buses ko replace kiya jayega.
items.who: Delhi-NCR ke transporters aur fleet owners jin ke paas purane trucks ya buses hain.
items.action: Scheme ke guidelines follow kar ke replacement ke liye apply karein, notified authority se details lein.

items.headline: GST Council set to take up major process overhaul
items.what: GST Council is planning to discuss the next round of GST reforms, focusing on overhauling compliance processes to boost ease of doing business. These changes follow reforms initiated last year.
items.who: Businesses, traders, startups, and GST professionals across India.
items.action: Track GST Council announcements for new compliance procedures that may be rolled out soon.

items.headline: Delhi launches Rs 65-cr DRISHTI project to push PM-UDAY scheme
items.what: A Rs 65-crore DRISHTI project has started to give a fresh boost to the PM-UDAY scheme in Delhi. This aims at regularizing unauthorized colonies.
items.who: Property owners and residents in Delhi’s unauthorized colonies under PM-UDAY.
items.action: Residents should keep documents ready for verification or updates related to property regularisation.

items.headline: Punjab Labour Code 2026: 10 big changes for HR & legal teams
items.what: Punjab Labour Code 2026 brings ten major changes making many HR decisions into legal matters. New rules are now notified impacting employment practices.
items.who: All businesses, factories, and offices employing staff in Punjab.
items.action: HR teams should study new code and update company HR policies, contracts, and compliance systems as per new law.

items.headline: Gujarat AAR: 5% GST on playground, 18% on gym equipment
items.what: Gujarat AAR clarified GST rates: 5% for outdoor playground equipment and parts, 18% for outdoor gym equipment and parts. Bearings placed under HSN 8482.
items.who: Manufacturers, importers, and sellers of playground and gym equipment in Gujarat.
items.action: Apply correct GST rate on invoices as per item—5% for playground, 18% for gym equipment.

items.headline: MCA notifies Indian Corporate Law Service Rules, 2026
items.what: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) has notified Indian Corporate Law Service Rules, 2026. Rules deal with recruitment, grades, service conditions, probation and promotions for Indian Corporate Law Service cadre.
items.who: Aspiring and current officers in Indian Corporate Law Service, legal and compliance departments tracking company law.
items.action: If you’re preparing for ICLS or HR in corporate compliance, download and review the new service rules from MCA website.

items.headline: Haryana extends One-Time Settlement deadline to 30 Nov 2026
items.what: Haryana government has extended the last date of its One-Time Settlement Scheme, 2026 till November 30, 2026. This gives more time for eligible taxpayers to settle pending dues.
items.who: Taxpayers in Haryana eligible under the One-Time Settlement Scheme, 2026.
items.action: If you qualify under the scheme, apply for settlement of dues by the new deadline.

items.headline: GST on geomembrane reduced to 5% from 22 Sep 2025
items.what: Gujarat AAR rules: Geomembrane under HSN 59111000 gets GST cut from 12% to 5%, effective from 22 September 2025.
items.who: Businesses dealing in geomembrane products under HSN 59111000.
items.action: From 22 Sep 2025, charge GST at 5% on applicable geomembrane transactions.

items.headline: Union Cabinet approves ₹10,000-cr SME Growth Fund
items.what: Union Cabinet ne ₹10,000-crore SME Growth Fund direct equity investments ke liye approve kiya hai. Fund MSMEs ko capital support dega.
items.who: Sab MSME units jo direct equity investment dhoond rahe hain.
items.action: MSMEs apne funding plans mein is naye fund ka use consider karein. Sarkari guidelines aur eligibility details dekhein.

items.headline: GST rate badlav sirf ek baar saal me, 1 April se
items.what: Finance Ministry sources ke mutabiq, GST rate me koi bhi badlav ab sirf saal me ek baar, 1 April se lagu honge. Isse businesses ko planning me aasani hogi.
items.who: Business owners, traders, manufacturers, GST registered entities.
items.action: GST compliance calendar update karein. Rate change ki planning ab 1 April ko hi consider karein.

items.headline: GST 2.0 launch: Registration aur refund process ab easy
items.what: GST Council ne GST 2.0 launch kiya hai. Ismein registration aur refund process ko aur bhi smooth banaya gaya hai.
items.who: Sab CGST registered businesses aur new applicants.
items.action: Naye registration aur refund ke processes ko GST portal par check karein. Updated guidelines follow karein.

items.headline: GST Council: 17 din me refund, easier ITC, registrations
items.what: GST Council naye reforms lane wala hai jaise 17 din me GST refunds, simplified registrations, aur input tax credit ko aasan banana agenda par hai.
items.who: GST registered businesses, tax professionals.
items.action: GST portal par updates aur new processes par nazar banayein. Refund filing process par focus karein.

items.headline: Playground aur gym equipment par alag GST rates
items.what: Gujarat AAR ne rule diya: outdoor playground equipment par 5% GST, gym equipment par 18% GST lagega. Bearings HSN 8482 mein aate hain.
items.who: Gujarat ke playground, gym equipment suppliers aur buyers.
items.action: GST invoices mein sahi rate lagayen. Billing karte waqt HSN code confirm karein.

items.headline: Haryana OTS scheme deadline ab 30 Nov 2026
items.what: Haryana ne One-Time Settlement Scheme, 2026 ki deadline 30 November 2026 tak badha di hai. Scheme mein dues settle kiye ja sakte hain.
items.who: Haryana ke taxpayers jinpar pending dues hain.
items.action: OTS scheme ka benefit lene ke liye 30 Nov 2026 tak apply karein. Portal ya office se process dekhein.

items.headline: Punjab: Industrial land leasehold to freehold at 5% fee
items.what: Punjab sarkar ne leasehold industrial land ko freehold convert karne ko approval de diya hai, 5% fee ke saath.

items.action: Agar aapke paas leasehold industrial plot hai, to 5% fee ke saath freehold conversion ke liye apply karein.

items.headline: GST Council meet 8 Oct, focus input credit relax on vehicles
items.what: GST Council ki meeting 8 October ko hai. Proposals mein 13 seater tak vehicles par input tax credit ki pabandiyan aasaan karne ki baat uthi hai.

items.action: 8 October ki meeting ke faisle ka intezar karein, fir vehicle purchase planning karein.

items.action: Naye date ki meeting ke faislon ka wait karein; GST compliance updates check karein.

items.headline: Playground equip par 5% GST, gym equip par 18%

items.headline: Delhi EV Policy 2026: 5,600+ applications, Rs 4.8 cr incentives
items.what: Delhi ki EV Policy 2026 ke tahat ab tak 5,600 se zyada applications mili hain aur 4.8 crore rupaye incentives release ho chuke hain.

items.headline: Haryana One-Time Settlement Scheme deadline ab 30 Nov 2026
items.what: Haryana ne One-Time Settlement Scheme 2026 ki deadline extend karke 30 November 2026 kar di hai.

items.headline: J&K Common Duct Policy 2026 notified
items.what: Jammu & Kashmir sarkar ne Common Duct Policy 2026 notify ki, taaki baar-baar road khod ke utility lines bichane ki zarurat na pade.

items.what: CBDT ne Tax Audit ki last date ab 21 October 2026 tak bada di hai. ITR ki due date bhi ab 21 November 2026 hai.

items.headline: 12% reservation for Agniveers in Assam Police, SDRF, Fire

items.what: Bihar sarkar ne regional airports par Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) par VAT ko zero kar diya hai UDAN scheme ke andar connectivity badhane ke liye.

items.what: Gujarat sarkar ne nayi Industrial Policy 2026 jari ki hai, jisme manufacturing aur startup sector ko prathmikta di gayi hai.

items.what: Jammu & Kashmir sarkar ne kachre se fuel banane ke liye Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) Policy 2026 notify ki hai.

items.headline: Tamil Nadu: Shops ko 365 din khula rakhne ki permission extend
items.what: Tamil Nadu ne dukaane aur establishments ko 365 din khula rakhne ki permission extend ki hai, kuch employee suraksha conditions ke saath.

items.what: Gujarat sarkar ne purane vehicles scrap karne par vehicle tax mein 50% chhoot approve ki hai.

items.what: Bihar sarkar ne regional airports par Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) par VAT zero kiya hai, taki sampark badhe.

items.what: Andhra Pradesh mein liquor shop ke liye application ki deadline extend kar ke 6 October tak kar di gayi hai.

items.headline: GSTN: Ab ek PAN se multiple states mein registration

items.headline: Gujarat: Vehicle scrap par 50% vehicle tax concession
items.what: Gujarat sarkar ne vehicle scrapping par 50% vehicle tax concession approve kar diya hai. Yaani purane gaadi scrap karne par tax mein chhoot milegi.

items.who: Sab GST registered businesses par lagu.

items.action: 1 October 2026 se naye tariff values ko import calculations mein include karein.

items.what: Jammu and Kashmir sarkar ne Electric Vehicle Policy 2026 notify kari hai. Nayi policy electric mobility ko promote karti hai.
items.who: J&K ke auto, logistics sector, EV manufacturers, aur businesses.
items.action: Nayi policy ke incentive aur compliance points ko study karein agar EV segment mein kaam karte hain.

items.action: Scheme ke guidelines aur application procedure ko dekhein agar biogas sector mein kaam karte hain.

items.action: Meetings ki minutes banate waqt SS-1 aur SS-2 standards ko strictly follow karein.

items.action: Import classification aur customs paperwork mein sahi HSN use karein.

items.what: Delhi government ne MSME Conclave organize kiya. Conclave ne local enterprises ke support pe highlight diya hai.
items.who: Delhi ki MSMEs aur startups ke liye.

items.headline: Karnataka GST collection Rs 2.04 lakh crore, 14.7% growth
items.what: Karnataka mein September 2026 GST collection 14.7% badha, total Rs 2.04 lakh crore hua.
items.who: Karnataka ke GST registered businesses.
items.action: Monthly GST return ki filing timely karein, increased compliance focus rakhein.

items.what: CBDT ne audit cases ki income tax return file karne ki deadline extend kar di hai. Ab naye date pe file kar sakte hain.

items.action: Aap audit cases ki return ab extended last date tak file kar sakte hain.

items.headline: India ne sugar export par turant ban lagaya, Sept 2026 tak
items.what: Bharat sarkar ne sugar ki export par abhi se turant pratibandh laga diya hai. Yeh ban September 2026 tak rahega.

items.action: Sugar export ab turant band kar dein. Koi bhi naya export shipment book na karein.

items.headline: RoDTEP scheme exporters ke liye 3 mahine badha
items.what: Centre ne RoDTEP (export incentive scheme) ki validity ab 31 December 2026 tak badha di hai. Exporters ko aur 3 mahine ka samay mil gaya hai.

items.action: RoDTEP ke tahat apna claim ab 31 Dec tak file karen. Scheme ki extended period ko dhyan mein rakhen.

items.what: Kapda aur made-up goods export par milne wali RoSCTL scheme ki validity 3 mahine badh gayi hai. Ab aur time milega incentive claim karne ka.

items.what: Section 8 company ke objectives badalne par naya ROC approval mandatory hai. Agar naya object 12A ya 80G se match nahi karta to fir se tax registration lena pad sakta hai.
items.who: All Section 8 companies jinke tax exemption registration hai.
items.action: Object change se pehle tax compliance aur approval ka assessment karein; ROC aur tax registration ki process samjhein.

items.headline: MSME clearance ab 15 din mein Haryana me
items.what: Haryana government ka naya business law MSME clearances sirf 15 din mein dene ka nishchit karta hai. Ab lambi pratiksha nahi hogi.
items.who: MSME units jo Haryana mein naya business shuru karna chahte hain.
items.action: Apni approval application submit karen, process ab tezi se hoga. Delay hone par complaint kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Natural Gas VAT Chandigarh mein 12.5% se 5% hua
items.what: Chandigarh administration ne natural gas par VAT 12.5% se 5% par la diya hai. Yani ab natural gas par tax kam hoga.
items.who: Jo businesses ya establishments natural gas use karte hain Chandigarh mein.
items.action: Apne purchase/sales invoice mein updated VAT rate ka use karein. Accounts ko accordingly adjust karein.

items.headline: MSMEs ke liye TReDS platform par credit guarantee system launch
items.what: Sarkar ne MSMEs ke liye TReDS platforms par naya credit guarantee system introduce kiya hai. Ab MSMEs factoring aur bill discounting pe better facility le sakte hain.
items.who: MSMEs jo TReDS platform ka use karte hain working capital ke liye.
items.action: Agar MSME hai to naye credit guarantee options ka faayda lene ke liye TReDS operator se sampark karein.

items.headline: Godown rent for agri warehousing par 18% GST: AAR Gujarat
items.what: AAR Gujarat ne decide kiya ki agricultural warehousing ke godown rent par 18% GST lagega. 10.10.2024 se unregistered persons se hired godowns par RCM bhi lagega.
items.who: Warehousing business aur farmers/agri traders jo Gujarat me unregistered se godown rent karte hain.
items.action: Godown rent billing par 18% GST lagayein. Unregistered landlord se rent par 10.10.2024 se RCM ka dhyan rakhein.

items.headline: Section 8 company object change may impact tax exemption
items.what: Section 8 company agar apne object badalta hai to ROC approval chahiye. Naye object agar registration se nahi milte to 12A/80G tax exemption dobara lena pad sakta hai.
items.who: Section 8 (NGO-type) companies registered under Companies Act.
items.action: Object change se pehle compliance check karo. Naye registration apply karo agar object tax laws se nahi milte.

items.headline: Sunday ko bhi khule rahenge Punjab excise office property tax ke liye
items.what: Punjab ke excise offices Sunday ko bhi property tax collection ke liye khule rahenge.
items.who: Punjab ke property owners jo tax jama karna chahte hain.
items.action: Tax jama karne ke liye Sunday ko bhi office ja sakte hain.

items.headline: AP mein GST AAR reconstitute, naye members appointed
items.what: Andhra Pradesh sarkar ne GST Advance Ruling Authority (AAR) ko reconstitute kiya hai. State Tax aur Central Tax ke naye members appoint hue hain.
items.who: GST registered dealers, tax professionals, applicants in Andhra Pradesh.
items.action: Advance ruling ki applications ab naye AAR panel ke saamne dalein.

items.headline: Chandigarh: Natural Gas VAT 12.5% se 5% hua
items.what: Chandigarh admin ne natural gas par VAT 12.5% se ghata kar 5% kiya hai.
items.who: Natural gas supply, trade, industry in Chandigarh.
items.action: Agla bill dekhte time updated VAT rate ka hisaab rakhein.

items.headline: Fresh Psyllium Seeds par 5% GST lagu: Rajasthan AAR
items.what: Rajasthan AAR ne decide kiya hai ki fresh Psyllium seeds par 5% GST lagega, exemption nahi milegi.
items.who: Psyllium seeds business ya dealers Rajasthan mein.
items.action: Is item par 5% GST invoice mein lagayein, exemption claim mat karein.

items.headline: Godown rent (agri warehousing) par 18% GST lagega: Gujarat AAR
items.what: AAR Gujarat ne decide kiya ki agricultural warehousing ke godown rent par 18% GST lagega. Unregistered godown se hire karne par RCM 10.10.2024 se apply hoga.
items.who: Warehousing, agri supply chain companies Gujarat mein.
items.action: Godown rent par 18% GST charge karein ya pay karein. Agar unregistered se godown liya hai to 10.10.2024 se RCM follow karein.

items.headline: Delhi govt ko 5,500+ EV incentive applications mile
items.what: Nayi electric vehicle (EV) policy ke tahat, Delhi govt ko 5,500 se jyada applications incentive ke liye mile hain.
items.who: Delhi mein EV buyers ya businesses incentive lene wale.
items.action: Agar application daali hai to processing ka wait karein. Nayi applications EV policy ke tahat dalein.

items.headline: Cinema equipment leasing par highest GST rate: Telangana AAR
items.what: Telangana AAR ne maana hai ki projectors, servers, UPS, VSAT ka leasing ek mixed supply hai aur bundle pe highest GST rate lagega.
items.who: Cinema equipment lease karne wale, multiplex, suppliers Telangana mein.
items.action: Sab equipment ke bundle pe highest GST rate lagakar GST pay karein.

items.headline: Haryana business law: 15-day clearance rule for MSMEs
items.what: Naya kanoon: MSME ko business clearance process sirf 15 din mein poora hoga, lamba wait khatam.
items.who: Haryana ke MSME businesses jo approval ya clearance ka wait karte hain.
items.action: Naye business, license ya clearance ke liye ab 15 din mein update milega. Process start karte hi ye rule check karein.

items.headline: Import/Export of 47 Chemicals: IUPAC & CAS Number Mandatory
items.what: CBIC ne 47 dual-use chemicals ke import/export declarations mein mandatory IUPAC name aur CAS number mangne ka proposal diya hai. Yeh 15 October 2026 se lagu hoga.
items.who: Sab importers/exporters jo in 47 chemicals ka kaam karte hain.
items.action: Declarations mein IUPAC name aur CAS number add karne ki taiyari karein.

items.headline: Warehousing Rules Draft: CBIC Seeks Stakeholder Feedback
items.what: CBIC ne Draft Warehousing Operations Regulations, 2026 issue kiya hai aur stakeholders se 15 din mein comments maange hain. Yeh regulations public aur private warehouses par lagu honge.
items.who: Sab warehouse operators, importers/exporters aur business jo warehouse use karte hain.
items.action: Draft regulations padhein aur feedback 15 din ke andar bhejein.

items.headline: Property Sale: NRI Se Property Kharidne Par TDS Rules Easy From 1 Oct
items.what: Income Tax Department ne 1 October 2026 se NRI se property kharidne par TDS compliance simple kiya hai. Kuch provisions hata diye hain.
items.who: Jo log NRI se property purchase kar rahe hain.
items.action: Naye TDS rules check karein aur property transaction karne se pehle compliance samjhein.

items.headline: Registration Forms Badle, Last Date Now March 2027
items.what: CBDT ne Notification No. 120/2026 se kuch registration forms update kiye hain aur filing ki last date ab 31 March 2027 kar di hai.
items.who: Jinke liye registration filing relevant hai jaise trusts, institutions etc.
items.action: Aapke registrations agar pending hain to naye forms mein file karein aur deadline ka dhyan rakhein.

items.headline: DURGA Scheme: 1,300 Pink E-Autos for Women/Transgender
items.what: Delhi Govt ne 'DURGA' scheme approve ki hai. Iske tahat 1,300 pink e-autos mahila aur transgender logon ke liye hongi.
items.who: Women aur transgender persons jo Dilli mein e-auto drive karna chahte hain.
items.action: Scheme ki guidelines padhein aur apply karne ke process ki taiyari karein.

items.headline: Global Capability Centres Policy 2024: UP Sarkar Ne Launch Kiya
items.what: Uttar Pradesh Sarkar ne Global Capability Centres Policy, 2024 roll out ki hai jisme incentives aur eligibility norms diye gaye hain.
items.who: Global firms aur startups jo UP mein capability centre kholna chahte hain.
items.action: Policy ki terms dekhein aur yadi eligible hai to incentives ka benefit lein.

items.headline: Clearance for MSME 15 Din Mein: Haryana's New Law
items.what: Haryana Sarkar ne naya business law pass kiya hai jisse MSMEs ko clearance sirf 15 din mein mil jayegi, ab der nahi hogi.
items.who: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) in Haryana jo new setup ya license ke liye apply karte hain.
items.action: MSME units ab faster clearance ke liye apply karein. Kaam delays mein complain kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Fresh Psyllium Seeds Par 5% GST, Exemption Nahi: Rajasthan AAR
items.what: Rajasthan AAR ne bola fresh Psyllium seeds par 5% GST lagega (HSN 12119013), exemption nahi milegi.
items.who: Psyllium seeds bechne wale, import/export ya process karne wale Rajasthan mein.
items.action: Fresh Psyllium seeds ki billing 5% GST par karein, exemption claim na karein.

items.headline: Delhi fire service rules extension ka proposal
items.what: Delhi government ne fire service amendment rules, 2025 ko 3 mahine extend karne ka proposal diya hai.
items.who: Delhi ke industrial, commercial unit holders, fire NOC lene wale logon par asar padega.
items.action: Agar aapko fire NOC chahiye ya renewal pending hai, extension ke liye government ka final notification ka intezaar karein.

items.headline: Mutual Credit Guarantee Scheme for MSMEs revised
items.what: Government ne Mutual Credit Guarantee Scheme revise ki hai, taaki MSME manufacturers aur exporters ko support mil sake.
items.who: MSME manufacturers aur exporters jo credit guarantee ka benefit lena chahte hain.
items.action: Scheme ke naye guidelines check karein aur eligibility ke hisaab se application karein.

items.headline: Chandigarh ne natural gas VAT 12.5% se 5% kiya
items.what: Chandigarh administration ne natural gas par VAT rate 12.5% se ghata kar 5% kar diya hai.
items.who: Chandigarh ke natural gas consumers, businesses aur industrial users par sidha asar padega.
items.action: Apne billing aur cost calculation ko naye VAT rate ke hisaab se update karein.

items.headline: Professional coaching (ACCA/CMA/CPA) par GST exemption nahi
items.what: Kerala AAR ne faisla diya hai ki ACCA, CMA, CPA jaise courses ki professional coaching services GST se exempt nahi hai. Exam fees, study material, forex gains, university training par bhi decision diya gaya.
items.who: Kerala mein coaching institutes aur ACCA, CMA, CPA aspirants.
items.action: Coaching providers aur students ab GST ka dhyaan rakhein, invoices mein GST include karein.

items.headline: Nata De Coco GST rate 18% se 5% ho gaya
items.what: Kerala AAR ne Nata De Coco ko HSN 21069099 mein classify kiya hai. Is par 21.09.2025 tak 18% aur 22.09.2025 se 5% GST lagega.
items.who: Kerala ke food manufacturers, distributors aur Nata De Coco import/export karne wale.
items.action: Apni GST rate mapping update karen, 22.09.2025 ke baad Nata De Coco par sirf 5% GST lagayen.

items.headline: Chandigarh DLSA advocates empanelment scheme approved
items.what: Justice Anoop Chitkara ne Chandigarh District Legal Services Authority ke liye advocates ke empanelment ki scheme approve ki hai.
items.who: Chandigarh ke practicing advocates jo DLSA panel mein shamil hona chahte hain.
items.action: Interested advocates DLSA ki panel empanelment scheme ki guidelines follow karke apply karein.

items.headline: Jaipur ICD Dhanakya, food imports ke liye naya entry point
items.what: CBIC ne Jaipur ke ICD Dhanakya ko food import ke liye authorized point of entry declare kiya hai. Ab notified PoEs ki sankhya 172 ho gayi.
items.who: Food importers, customs clearing agents, distributors jo Jaipur region mein kaam karte hain.
items.action: Food imports ke liye nayi list dekhein aur Jaipur ICD Dhanakya ka use kar sakte hain.

items.headline: UP ne ₹2,606 crore industrial investment approve kiya
items.what: Uttar Pradesh government ne ₹2,606 crore ke naye industrial investment projects approve kiye hain.
items.who: UP ke industrialists, investors, naye factory/plant lagane wale vyakti aur sangathan.
items.action: Naye projects mein shaamil hone ke liye UP govt schemes ya allotment/land allotment applications follow karein.

items.headline: Natural gas VAT 12.5% se 5% hua Chandigarh mein
items.what: Chandigarh administration ne natural gas par VAT rate 12.5% se ghata kar 5% kar diya hai. Yeh businesses ko sasti natural gas provide karega.
items.who: Chandigarh mein natural gas use karne wale industries, traders, CNG stations.
items.action: Apne VAT billing system update karein. Nai rate ka hisaab karein apne costing mein.

items.headline: Leasehold se freehold industrial conversion Punjab mein, 5% fee
items.what: Punjab sarkar ne leasehold industrial properties ko freehold mein convert karne ki permission di hai. Iske liye 5% charge lagega.
items.who: Punjab ke industrial property owners jo leasehold property ko freehold me badalna chahte hain.
items.action: Agar aap conversion chahte hain toh application file karein, 5% fee ka intezam karein.

items.headline: EPFO PF withdrawal claim process will be automatic soon
items.what: EPFO ne PF withdrawal claims settlement ko automate karne ka faisla liya hai. Automated system se claims jaldi settle honge.
items.who: EPF members jo PF withdrawal claim lagana chahte hain.
items.action: Future claims ke liye EPFO portal se online track kar paenge. Manual follow-up ki zarurat kam hogi.

items.headline: Valuer aur Tax Practitioner registration ki deadline 31 March 2027 tak badhi
items.what: CBDT ne Valuer aur Tax Practitioner ki registration ki deadline 31 March 2027 tak extend ki hai aur Income-tax Rules, 2026 ke Forms 169/171 replace kiye hain.
items.who: Valuers aur Tax Practitioners jo CB​DT mein registration karte hain.
items.action: Nayi deadline ke hisaab se registration kara lein, naye forms ka istemal karein.

items.headline: 8 online services ki inspection ab 7 din mein J&K mein
items.what: Jammu & Kashmir Govt ne 8 online services (BRAP) ke inspection ke liye 7 din ki deadline fix ki hai. Fast clearances ke liye yeh kadam uthaya gaya hai.
items.who: J&K ke MSMEs, businessmen, jo BRAP ke antargat online service apply karte hain.
items.action: Inspection request file karte waqt yeh deadline dhyan mein rakhein. Burden of follow-up kam hoga.

items.headline: ICD Dhanakya, Jaipur food import entry point ban gaya
items.what: CBIC ne ICD Dhanakya, Jaipur ko food import entry points ki list mein add kar diya hai. Ab yahan bhi food consignments import ho sakte hain.
items.who: Jaipur ke importers/distributors jo food items mangwate hain.
items.action: Import planning mein naye entry point ka option samjhein, ab wahan se bhi food item import possible hai.

items.headline: 15 lakh UP farmers PM-Kisan par suspicious, verification ki last date 30 Sept
items.what: 15 lakh UP farmers ko PM-Kisan database me 'suspicious' category me daala gaya hai. Inki verification 30 September tak honi hai, nahi to payment ruk sakti hai.
items.who: UP ke wo farmers jinhe PM-Kisan ka paisa milta hai aur data 'suspicious' flag ho gaya hai.
items.action: UP farmers ya unke agents turant verification kara lein, warna PM-Kisan ka payment ruk sakta hai.

items.headline: EPFO wage ceiling hiked to ₹25,000
items.what: Cabinet ne EPFO ki mandatory coverage ke liye wage ceiling ₹15,000 se badha kar ₹25,000 kar di hai. Labour Ministry ne is par Gazette notification bhi jaari kiya hai.
items.who: Har employer jinke employees ab ₹15,000-₹25,000 monthly wage bracket mein aate hain.
items.action: HR aur payroll system mein naya wage ceiling apply karein aur affected employees ke liye EPFO compliance karein.

items.headline: IT Forms 169, 171 revised; deadline badha
items.what: CBDT ne Income Tax ke Forms 169 aur 171 revise kiye hain aur inke submission ki deadline extend kar di hai. Naye rules ab lagu hain.
items.who: Taxpayers aur practitioners jo in forms ka use karte hain.
items.action: Latest notified forms ka use karein aur nayi deadline tak file karein.

items.headline: Tax valuer, practitioner registration deadline March 2027 tak
items.what: CBDT ne tax valuer aur practitioner registrations ki deadline March 2027 tak badha di hai.
items.who: Tax valuers aur income tax practitioners jinhe abhi tak registration nahi mila.
items.action: March 2027 tak registration apply karein ya renewal kara lein.

items.headline: Cabinet ne Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojna approve ki
items.what: Cabinet ne naye industrial development initiative Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojna ko manzoori di hai.
items.who: All businesses aur manufacturers jo industrial policy se jude hain.
items.action: Policy ke final notification ka intzaar karein, implement hone par benefit ya compliance dekhein.

items.headline: UPI payments: GST on merchant charges par, customers par nahi
items.what: Sarkari sources bol rahe hain ki UPI payments par GST sirf MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) par lagu hai, lekin customers ko yeh charge nahi diya jaana chahiye.
items.who: All UPI merchants aur payment service providers.
items.action: MDR par GST collect karo, lekin customer se extra charge na lo.

items.headline: Gujarat GIS mapping of MSMEs shuru kar raha hai
items.what: Gujarat sarkar MSMEs ka GIS-based mapping start kar rahi hai jisse industrial data PM Gati Shakti se link kiya ja sake.
items.who: Gujarat ke saare MSMEs.
items.action: Apne unit ka latest data local authority ko de, GIS mapping mein cooperate karein.
